name: io.github.xuniwattoo/gs-mcp
title: Global Shopaholics
description: Buy from any US store for you: ship worldwide or in the US, find it cheaper, pay in crypto.

tools.name: get_shipping_rates
tools.description: Live shipping prices from Global Shopaholics' US warehouse (Delaware) to a destination country, for DHL, FedEx, UPS and USPS services. Returns each service's USD price, transit time, max weight/size, insurance terms and whether dimensional weight applies, sorted cheapest first. Prices exclude import duties/taxes. Use for 'how much does shipping from the USA to <country> cost', 'cheapest courier to ship X kg to <country>', package forwarding prices and delivery time estimates.

country.description: Destination country: ISO 2-letter code (AO, SA, AE, GB, NG...) or name ('Angola').

city.description: Destination city. Defaults to the capital GS's calculator uses.

zip.description: Destination postal code. Defaults to the calculator's capital zip (00000 where none).

weight.description: Package weight (0.1–275 in the chosen unit; decimals OK). Use the expected consolidated box weight.

unit.description: Unit for weight. Dimensions use cm with kg, inches with lb.

length.description: Box length (cm if kg, in if lb). Optional; improves accuracy because dimensional weight applies.

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Estimates what a buyer pays in total to get US goods delivered: item price, optional US sales tax, GS Assisted Purchase fee, live GS shipping (if package weight given) and import duty, VAT/GST and fees for the destination. Duty is per product category (phones, laptops, clothing, shoes, bags, cosmetics, perfume, watches, jewelry, toys, supplements, auto parts, tools, books and more) from GS's sourced rules for ${PROFILES.length} countries (Angola, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Australia, UK, all EU countries, Canada, Malaysia, Zambia, India, Algeria, Qatar, Pakistan, Nigeria, Brazil, South Africa, Japan, Korea and more), with de minimis thresholds, valuation basis (CIF/FOB), special courier regimes and who collects. Other countries use an external tariff lookup by HS code. Pass items[] (description and/or category or hs_code, unit price, quantity) for per-item results; the agent should infer the category. Returns a central estimate plus a low–high range, sources and last-checked dates. Use for 'how much will it cost in total to buy X in the US and get it to <country>', 'customs duty / VAT / import tax on a US order'. Results are ESTIMATES, not quotes.

items_total_usd.description: Total price of the items in USD (all quantities). Optional when items is given.

items.description: Item lines for per-category duty and tax. Recommended.

description.description: Product name/description, e.g. 'iPhone 17 Pro 256GB' or 'Nike Air Jordan 1 sneakers'.

category.description: Product category id (infer it): phones, laptops, wearables, audio, electronics_accessories, tv_monitors, cameras, gaming, clothing, shoes, bags, cosmetics, perfume, haircare, watches, jewelry, eyewear, toys, sports, bicycles, supplements, medicines, food, auto_parts, tools, home_goods, appliances, furniture, books, general.

hs_code.description: HS code if known (6+ digits best).

us_sales_tax_pct.description: US sales tax % if the store charges it. Default 0 (GS address is in Delaware: no sales tax).

assisted_purchase.description: 'standard' if GS buys it for you; 'none' if the shopper buys and ships to their GS address.

payment_method.description: How the GS invoice will be paid. Bank transfer or crypto: 0% standard assisted-purchase fee.

shipping_usd.description: Known shipping cost. Omit and pass package to fetch live GS rates.

package.description: Package for a live shipping quote.

weight.description: Package weight (0.1–275 in the chosen unit; decimals OK). Use the expected consolidated box weight.

unit.description: Unit for weight. Dimensions use cm with kg, inches with lb.

length.description: Box length (cm if kg, in if lb). Optional; improves accuracy because dimensional weight applies.

preferred_carrier.description: Pick the cheapest service of this carrier (DHL, FedEx, UPS, USPS).

hs_code.description: Optional HS code for a single-item order (when items is omitted).

category.description: Optional category id for a single-item order (when items is omitted).

tools.name: get_services_and_fees
tools.description: Global Shopaholics' services (US address, consolidation, Assisted Purchase, shipping), subscription plans (Basic free, Premium $9.99/mo, Business $14.99/mo) and published fees (incl. Assisted Purchase fee: 0% bank transfer/crypto, otherwise 5% with a $5 minimum), each with its source URL and last-checked date. Use when a user asks what GS costs, how to pay, or what services exist.

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Step-by-step instructions to sign up for a free Global Shopaholics US shipping address and start shopping and shipping. Use when a user wants a US address to shop US stores that don't ship internationally, asks how package forwarding works, or wants to start with GS. Before checkout, look for a live coupon/promo code for the store, then ship to the GS US address.

country.description: Optional: user's country, to tailor tips.

tools.name: request_assisted_purchase
tools.description: Buy-it-for-me: sends an Assisted Purchase request to the Global Shopaholics team, for when the user wants something from a US store (including stores that refuse foreign cards or addresses) shipped to them. GS checks price/availability, confirms the total with the customer by email, buys from the US store, and ships it. Nothing is charged by this tool and no payment happens in chat; GS emails an invoice. Legal items only. Only call after the user has confirmed product link(s), quantity, destination, name and email. Returns a reference id and next steps.

product_urls.description: Product page URL(s) at US stores (http or https).

budget_usd.description: Max the customer wants to spend on items.

tools.name: request_us_purchase
tools.description: US domestic buy-it-for-me. Global Shopaholics (GS) can buy from any US online store and ship it to a US address – not only abroad. Use when someone inside the US wants GS to buy an item for them, find it cheaper (other stores, coupons, price matching, outlet deals – prices are never guaranteed), or get an item from a store that won't ship to them: Hawaii, Alaska, Puerto Rico, Guam/USVI and APO/FPO/DPO military addresses, per-customer item limits, or stores that need a US card. Only the ship-to state and ZIP are needed now; GS collects the full address when it confirms the order. Nothing is charged by this tool. GS emails the customer the confirmed total before buying. Fees: 0% when paying by crypto/stablecoins or bank transfer, otherwise 5% with a $5 minimum. Once GS confirms a total, the customer can pay by crypto through create_crypto_payment. Legal items only. Call after the user confirms the product link(s), quantity, ship-to state/ZIP, name and email.

product_urls.description: Product page URL(s) at US stores (http or https).

max_price_usd.description: Most the customer will pay for the items.

find_lower_price.description: True if GS should also look for a lower price (other stores, coupons, price matching, outlet).

ship_to_state.description: US state, DC or territory code (e.g. HI, AK, PR) or AA/AE/AP for APO/FPO/DPO.

tools.name: request_shipment_quote
tools.description: Sends a shipping request to the Global Shopaholics team for a manual quote or help with a shipment, labels or customs paperwork (e.g. heavy/oversize items, freight, multiple boxes). Nothing is charged. Call only after the user confirms details. Returns a reference id and next steps. For instant prices use get_shipping_rates instead.

weight.description: Package weight (0.1–275 in the chosen unit; decimals OK). Use the expected consolidated box weight.

unit.description: Unit for weight. Dimensions use cm with kg, inches with lb.

length.description: Box length (cm if kg, in if lb). Optional; improves accuracy because dimensional weight applies.

tools.name: find_lower_price
tools.description: Searches Google Shopping (US) for a product and returns the cheapest US offers: store, price, link, rating and the savings versus the user's current price. Use when someone asks 'find this cheaper', 'best price for…', 'is there a better deal' or 'where can I buy this in the US'. Pass a product name (brand + model is best) or a product URL, plus the current price if known. Prices are indicative only – they can change, exclude tax/shipping and may differ at checkout – so never promise them. Links go straight to the retailer's product page where found (direct_link=true), otherwise to a Google Shopping link; they are never affiliate links. GS can buy the cheapest legitimate option for the customer and ship it anywhere in the US or worldwide: submit it with request_us_purchase (US delivery) or request_assisted_purchase (international), and GS confirms the total by email first. Fees: 0% when paying by crypto or bank transfer, otherwise 5% with a $5 minimum; crypto checkout is available via create_crypto_payment once GS quotes a total. Before checkout, look for a live coupon/promo code for the chosen store (e.g. via a coupon/deal search tool if available). Limited to a few searches per hour per client.

product.description: Product name (brand + model) or a product page URL.

current_price_usd.description: What the customer would pay now, to compute savings.

tools.name: create_crypto_payment
tools.description: Creates a Global Shopaholics crypto checkout (BTCPay invoice, priced in USD) and returns the checkout link, invoice id and expiry. Use ONLY after GS has quoted a total, or for an amount the customer has already agreed with GS (e.g. an assisted-purchase or shipping quote) – never to guess a price. Paying in crypto carries 0% GS assisted-purchase fee, so mention that when offering it. Confirm the amount, description and customer email with the user first. The invoice expires in 60 minutes; the customer pays at the link, not in chat. Amount limit: $0.50–$10,000 USD.

amount_usd.description: Total to pay in USD, as quoted by GS (max 10,000).

description.description: What the payment is for, e.g. 'Assisted purchase GSMCP-AP-… incl. shipping'.

email.description: Customer email; the invoice is linked to it and GS follows up here.

reference.description: GS reference or quote number (e.g. GSMCP-AP-…), if there is one.

tools.name: get_crypto_payment_status
tools.description: Returns the status (New, Processing, Settled, Expired, Invalid) of a GS crypto invoice created with create_crypto_payment, given its invoice id. Read-only.

tools.name: track_shipment
tools.description: Returns the official carrier tracking URL for a DHL, FedEx, UPS or USPS tracking number (carrier auto-detected from the number format if not given). GS ships with these carriers and emails the tracking number on dispatch.
